wiki.quote: Многие в моей колонии рождены сражаться, работать или приносить потомство. Я же из касты избранных. Избранных убивать!

entries.name: Axe
lines: A well-timed Berserker's Call can expose Nyx Assassin while he is invisible with Vendetta, and prevent him from using Spiked Carapace.
Axe can use Battle Hunger's damage over time to minimialize effects of Spiked Carapace.

Axe's high health also allows him to easily shrug off Nyx Assassin's burst damage and fend him off. Especially since Axe is a common Heart of Tarrasque wielder, which can completely eliminate any chance for Nyx Assassin to kill Axe alone.
Culling Blade can often kill Nyx Assassin as he is very fragile and vulnerable to damage while Spiked Carapace is on cooldown.

entries.name: Bounty Hunter
lines: Track hinders Nyx Assassin's ganking and escaping attempts with Vendetta, making him an easy kill for gold as well.
Bounty Hunter can also use Track on Nyx Assassin while he has Spiked Carapace active without getting stunned as Track deals no damage at all before using Shuriken Toss.

entries.name: Bloodseeker
lines: While Burrowing, Nyx is an easy target for a Blood Rite, and his only way to counter it is a well-timed Spiked Carapace.
Thirst is always a threat to Nyx Assassin, hindering his attempt of escape using Vendetta and rendering him unable to surprise Bloodseeker's allies.
Rupture also prevents Nyx Assassin from escaping with Vendetta, as it forces him to stay still.

entries.name: Brewmaster
lines: Cyclone from Storm in Primal Split can waste Nyx's Spiked Carapace, since its duration is shorter than the Cyclone's.

entries.name: Doom
lines: A well-timed Doom prevents Nyx Assassin escaping with Vendetta and fighting back with Spiked Carapace.
Doom's high health also allows him to easily shrug off Nyx Assassin's burst damage and fend him off.

entries.name: Juggernaut
lines: Juggernaut's entire skillset greatly counters Nyx Assassin's Spiked Carapace, his most important ability.

Blade Fury allows Juggernaut to freely attack Nyx Assassin, and deal heavy damage to Nyx Assassin. Nyx Assassin cannot counter Blade Fury with Spiked Carapace because Blade Fury gives Juggernaut spell immunity. And besides Vendetta, Nyx Assassin has no other way of dealing damage to Juggernaut while he is spell immune.
Healing Ward allows Juggernaut to recover himself and his allies from Nyx Assassin's damage output.

Omnislash and Swiftslash from Aghanim's Scepter can quickly finish off Nyx Assassin. And just like Blade Fury, Nyx Assassin cannot counter neither Omnislash and Swiftslash from Aghanim's Scepter with Spiked Carapace because both abilities render Juggernaut invulnerable. And if Nyx Assassin has no Vendetta available to use for escaping, both abilities will kill him very quickly before he can do anything.
Overall, any attempt for Nyx Assassin to gank and kill Juggernaut will hurt Nyx Assassin more than Juggernaut.

entries.name: Lifestealer
lines: Like with Juggernaut's Blade Fury, Rage allows Lifestealer to freely attack Nyx Assassin and hunt him down if Vendetta is on cooldown. Nyx Assassin cannot counter Rage with Spiked Carapace because Rage gives Lifestealer spell immunity. And besides Vendetta, Nyx Assassin has no other way of dealing damage to Lifestealer while he is spell immune.

Open Wounds from Aghanim's Shard allows Lifestealer to severely slow down Nyx Assassin while also allowing his team to recover themselves while attacking Nyx Assassin. Open Wounds can also fester and spread if Nyx Assassin takes enough damage that will trigger the spread while he is affected with Open Wounds.

Infest combined with an ancient creep makes Nyx Assassin an easy target to surprise with Dust of Appearance or a Gem of True Sight. And similarly to Juggernaut's Omnislash and Swiftslash from Aghanim's Scepter, Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Infest can also allow Lifestealer to infest, disarm and freely attack Nyx Assassin from within. And Nyx Assassin cannot counter this with Spiked Carapace because Lifestealer is invulnerable while attacking the infested enemy hero from within.
Like with Juggernaut, any attempt for Nyx Assassin to gank and kill Lifestealer will hurt Nyx Assassin more than Lifestealer.

entries.name: Luna
lines: Even though Nyx Assassin can easily kill Luna with his high burst damage, Luna can also do the same to him if he is not careful.

Lucent Beam can deal a fair amount of damage to Nyx Assassin if he has no Spiked Carapace available to use. Although Luna should be patient using Lucent Beam on Nyx Assassin when he uses Spiked Carapace.

As Luna commonly buys Black King Bar, she can use it to freely attack Nyx Assassin whenever he tries to defend himself with Spiked Carapace during teamfights. Luna can also buy Eye of Skadi and Manta Style to survive Nyx Assassin's burst damage and distract him.
Though Vendetta can deal serious damage to Luna and avoid Eclipse, smart Luna will always buy Dust of Appearance to provide vision on Nyx Assassin to her and her team.

entries.name: Lycan
lines: Lycan's high health allows him to easily shrug off Nyx Assassin's burst damage and fend him off.
As Lycan commonly buys Black King Bar, he can use it to freely attack Nyx Assassin and chase after him with Shapeshift.
Lycan can also use his wolves from Summon Wolves to attack Nyx Assassin while he has Spiked Carapace active without getting stunned himself.

entries.name: Slardar
lines: Corrosive Haze hinders Nyx Assassin's ganking attempts with Vendetta, as well as reducing his armor and make him very vulnerable due to his low health pool.
Guardian Sprint allows Slardar to catch up with Nyx Asssassin and finish him off if he has vision over him.

entries.name: Viper
lines: Corrosive Skin minimizes the damage from Impale and Mind Flare, and anything else Nyx Assassin tries to throw at Viper.

Nyx Assassin cannot survive several poison damage-over-time output from Poison Attack, Nethertoxin, Corrosive Skin and Viper Strike, not even while he has Spiked Carapace active. And to make things worse, Nyx Assassin is not a common Silver Edge wielder to counter this problem at all.

entries.name: Visage
lines: Even though Visage's Familiars from Summon Familiars are fragile and can be killed quickly with Nyx Assassin's high burst damage, they can deal many instances of damage quickly, minimizing the effectiveness of Spiked Carapace.

Gravekeeper's Cloak and tanky item builds make Visage hard for Nyx to kill with his burst damage. Aghanim's Shard upgraded Gravekeeper's Cloak also allows Visage to use Stone Form to both recover himself and stun Nyx Assassin if he is close enough to Visage.
Visage's long range on Soul Assumption and Grave Chill make him hard to escape from, and Soul Assumption's low cooldown outmatches Spiked Carapace.

Abilities and items with Silence or Root are a threat to Nyx Assassin, the former is because his nature as an ability-reliant hero, the latter is because most of them does not allow him to fight back with Spiked Carapace or escape with Vendetta.
Heroes with high HP will easily shrug off Nyx Assassin's burst damage and fend him off.

Heroes who build Black King Bar as either core or situational item will be able to fight back against Nyx Assassin and freely attack him as Spiked Carapace cannot pierce spell immunity at all: Axe, Broodmother, Dawnbreaker, Enigma, Huskar, Jakiro, Legion Commander, Lina, Luna, Lycan, Slardar, Slark, Troll Warlord, Witch Doctor.
Mind Flare is nearly useless against heroes with very low intelligence like Huskar.

Heroes who rely on damage over time as Spiked Carapace can block and reflect only one instance of damage: Jakiro, Viper, Venomancer, Huskar, Ember Spirit, Dark Seer, Sand King, Doom, Dawnbreaker. However, this also means they are easily stunned.
Nyx Assassin is ability-dependent and thus vulnerable to silence, especially while Burrowed.

Some abilities deals damage from an independent source and not from the hero itself, so Nyx cannot counter them with Spiked Carapace: illusions or summoning units, Homing Missile, Nimbus, Mass Serpent Ward, Death Ward and especially Techies's mines.

Nyx Assassin's skillset is mostly single-targeted, therefore he will have difficulties against heroes with illusions and summons: Naga Siren, Broodmother, Lycan, Visage, Phantom Lancer. And to make things worse, Nyx Asassin is not a common Battle Fury, Maelstrom, Mjollnir, Gleipnir or Radiance wielder to counter this problem.
Any detection items such as (Gem of True Sight, Sentry Ward, Dust of Appearance and Gleipnir prevent Nyx Assassin from using Vendetta to initiate or escape.

Eul's Scepter of Divinity can waste Nyx's Spiked Carapace, since its duration is shorter than the Cyclone's. Later it can be upgraded into Wind Waker which can do the same and which can also be used to escape from Nyx Assassin.
Any good strength/health item like Eye of Skadi, Heart of Tarrasque or even Bloodstone and Octarine Core can completely eliminate Nyx's solo ganking as a threat.

Bloodthorn and Scythe of Vyse will silence Nyx Assassin, rendering him not only useless, but also defenseless and powerless as he will not be able to use neither Vendetta to escape nor Spiked Carapace to defend himself while disabled, making Nyx Assassin weak even against heroes he naturally counters.
Mage Slayer allows it's owners's attacks to weaken Nyx Assassin's spell damage each time he/she attacks him.
Pipe of Insight can protect multiple heroes from Nyx Assassin's spell damage.
Eternal Shroud can reduce all the damage Nyx Assassin tries to inflict on it's wielder while also converting inflicted damage into mana, thus nullifying effects of Vendetta.
Manta Style illusions can be used to attack Nyx Assassin when he tries to protect himself with Spiked Carapace, and make Nyx Assassin waste time attacking them.

Gleipnir can be used to root Nyx Assassin and reveal him while under the effects of Vendetta, allowing it's owner to alert himself/herself and his/her allies on Nyx Assassin's attempts to gank with Vendetta.
Aeon Disk can save it's wielder from getting nuked and killed by Nyx Assassin.

Lotus Orb is a double-edged sword against Nyx Assassin. While Nyx Assassin can counter it in return with Spiked Carapace, he will still suffer damage if he uses his abilities and items on a hero who is affected by it.

Black King Bar blocks most of Nyx Assassin's damage and greatly discourages Nyx Assassin from targeting a hero with spells or items while also allowing it's wielder to freely attack Nyx Assassin, making Nyx Assassin weak even against heroes he naturally counters. And unlike Lotus Orb, Nyx Assassin cannot punish this in return with Spiked Carapace because Spiked Carapace cannot pierce Spell Immunity at all. And outside from Vendetta, Nyx Assassin has no other ways to deal with Spell Immunity at all.

entries.name: Crystal Maiden
lines: Spiked Carapace easily interrupts Freezing Field.
Frostbite's damage over time sets up an easy Spiked Carapace stun.
Crystal Maiden is extremely fragile and dies quickly to Nyx Assassin's burst damage.

entries.name: Dawnbreaker
lines: Spiked Carapace interrupts Starbreaker before Dawnbreaker has her Aghanim's Shard, as well as Solar Guardian during the initial channel, making her ineffective at joining and dealing damage in teamfights.
The slow projectile and damage over time effect of Celestial Hammer makes it easy to stun Dawnbreaker if she attemps to engage or chase.

entries.name: Enchantress
lines: Spiked Carapace reflects the damage from Impetus.
Enchantress is a rather squishy hero, making her fall easily to Nyx Assassin's high burst damage.

entries.name: Enigma
lines: Enigma's uncontrollable damage from Malefice and Midnight Pulse make him easy to stun with Spiked Carapace.
Black Hole can be easily interrupted by Impale or Spiked Carapace.

entries.name: Ember Spirit
lines: Spiked Carapace can be easily triggered by Flame Guard or Battle Fury, setting up a deadly Impale.

entries.name: Medusa
lines: With her passive Split Shot, Medusa can be easily interrupted by Spiked Carapace during combat, especially during her precious Stone Gaze.
Mana Burn quickly destroys Mana Shield, especially if Medusa only increases her mana pool by bolstering intelligence (which has the added bonus of increasing Mana Burn's damage).
Uncontrollable damage from Mystic Snake and Split Shot can trigger Spiked Carapace.
Medusa lacks single target damage, making a Burrowed Nyx Assassin hard to kill.

entries.name: Outworld Destroyer
lines: Outworld Destroyer's high intelligence gain and fragility makes him an easy target for a massive Mana Burn, as well as killing him outwards with Nyx Assassin's high burst damage.

Astral Imprisonment can be easily exploited by Nyx Assassin with his abilities. As long as Astral Imprisonment was not cast on Nyx Assassin, it will make an opportunity for an easy stun, either by Spiked Carapace (if Outworld Destroyer hid his allies or your allies) or Impale (if he hid himself). If Astral Imprisonment was cast on Nyx Assassin, using Spiked Carapace while banished will proc the stun after the disable, since Spike Carapace has a 0 second cast time and Astral Imprisonment deals damage right after the disable ends.
An ill-timed Sanity's Eclipse and/or well timed Spiked Carapace can deal a lot of damage to Outworld Destroyer and stun him, unless Outworld Destroyer used Black King Bar beforehand.

entries.name: Phoenix
lines: Spiked Carapace reacts on any of the damage over time from Phoenix's abilities and can interrupt Sun Ray and Icarus Dive.

entries.name: Puck
lines: Illusory Orb is easy to reflect with Spiked Carapace, either stunning Puck and setting up an easy Impale or forcing a premature Phase Shift.
Puck is an intelligence hero that tends to build intelligence items, making it vulnerable to Mana Burn.
An ill-timed Phase Shift can easily set Puck up to be stunned by Impale.
Puck's low base armor and below average agility gain mean it is always susceptible to Vendetta.

entries.name: Pugna
lines: Nether Blast's animation makes it easy to time Spiked Carapace for a stun.
Pugna has the largest intelligence gain in the game, making him a prime target for Mana Burn.
Pugna needs to channel Life Drain, making him easy to hit with Impale.

entries.name: Silencer
lines: Last Word is extremely easy to reflect with Spiked Carapace for large amounts damage, due to triggering when Nyx Assassin casts a spell, but can still silence Nyx Assassin. It also has the added bonus of dealing more damage the more Intelligence Silencer has.
Glaives of Wisdom quickly builds Silencer's Intelligence, making him a particularly prime target for Mana Burn.
Silencer rarely builds survivability items, nor is he able to steal much Intelligence while surrounded by his team, and so is an excellent target for Vendetta.
Silencer has no reliable way of dealing with a burrowed Nyx, and also lacks the ability to prevent Nyx from escaping with Vendetta,

entries.name: Sniper
lines: Assassinate is easy to reflect with Spiked Carapace for massive damage.
Shrapnel's area damage can set up an easy stun with Spiked Carapace, especially when combined with Vendetta.
In the early game, Sniper's low health pool and high intelligence makes him easy prey for Nyx Assassin.

entries.name: Storm Spirit
lines: Mana Burn removes much-needed mana for Ball Lightning.
Spiked Carapace triggers on Static Remnant for an easy stun.

entries.name: Tinker
lines: Heat-Seeking Missile allow easy Spiked Carapace stuns.
As a fragile hero that relies on mana and intelligence items, Tinker is vulnerable to Mana Burn.
Nyx Assassin's stuns can interrupt Rearm and leave Tinker helpless.
The nature of some abilities turn them into an easy target for a turnover from Spiked Carapace:
Slow-moving projectiles: Skywrath Mage, Tinker, Necrophos
Large area-of-effect with delay or require channeling: Enigma, Crystal Maiden, Invoker, Shadow Fiend, Pugna, Keeper of the Light, Dawnbreaker.
Heroes with high intelligence gain and low durability are vulnerable to Mana Burn.
Positioning-dependent heroes are threatened by Vendetta: Ember Spirit, Drow Ranger.

Lotus Orb is a double-edged sword against Nyx Assassin: While Lotus Orb can discourage Nyx Assassin from targeting a hero with spells or items, Nyx Assassin can punish this in return with Spiked Carapace: While Spiked Carapace is available for Nyx Assassin to use. He can use Spiked Carapace, then Mana Burn a target with an active Lotus Orb, protecting him from the damage of the reflected mana burn (but not the burnt mana), reflecting the damage back and stunning the target.
This is better with a Dagon, since all it does is deal damage, resulting in a Lotus Orb backfiring and the target suffering twice the Dagon's damage.

This works even more effectively with the 175% Spiked Carapace talent (at level 20), as it reflects the Dagon's damage twice, resulting in the Dagon's damage tripling in total. With Dagon 5, this becomes an instant 2400 damage nuke and 2.4 second stun (before amplification/reduction).

Another thing is that Lotus Orb itself is a good item itself for Nyx Assassin. Alongside with Blade Mail, a combination of Dagon, Blade Mail, Lotus Orb, and Spiked Carapace hit on enemy with a Lotus Orb activated will deal about 2400(3000 with level 20 talent) magic damage (before reduction/amplification).

Items with area of effect damage may proc Spiked Carapace, stunning the wielders and allowing Nyx Assassin to follow with other abilities: Battle Fury, Maelstrom, Mjollnir, Shiva's Guard and most notably Radiance.

entries.name: Witch Doctor
lines: Witch Doctor's Maledict means that Nyx Assassin's Vendetta is almost always lethal
Witch Doctor's Death Ward and Voodoo Restoration pairs well with Nyx Assassin's multiple stuns

entries.name: Invoker
lines: Nyx Assassin's initiation potential works great in conjunction with Invoker's high damage spells.

entries.name: Legion Commander
lines: Nyx Assassin's high burst damage helps Legion Commander gain Duel damage.
Press the Attack removes silences and Dust of Appearance from Nyx Assassin.

entries.name: Lifestealer
lines: Nyx Assassin can initiate using Blink Dagger and Vendetta, making him an ideal Infest target.

entries.name: Bloodseeker
lines: Thirst helps Nyx Assassin locate and eliminate weakened enemies.
Rupture can help land Impale, which can in turn set up Blood Rite.
Heroes with global or very long range spells can help Nyx Assassin take out tougher enemies: Thor, Ancient Apparition, Spectre, Dawnbreaker.
Tanky heroes who can lure enemies to use their AoE nukes, allowing Nyx Assassin to counter-initiate with Spiked Carapace.
Heroes with area disables that can help Nyx Assassin land an Impale: Lion, Tidehunter, and Underlord.
Heroes with Boots of Travel 2 can take advantage of Vendetta to sneak behind enemy lines.

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango gives Nyx Assassin basic health sustain, allowing him to continue laning despite enemy harass.

entries.name: Clarity
lines: Clarity allows Nyx Assassin to replenish his mana pool in-lane, crucial since most of his spells will consume almost half his base mana pool with a single cast. Having the mana to continue casting gives Nyx Assassin more chances to use his disables to score kills.

entries.name: Iron Branch
lines: Iron Branch gives some attributes that increase health, mana, and damage.

entries.name: Enchanted Mango
lines: Enchanted Mango is a strong laning item, as it provides a small boost to HP regeneration, augmenting his innate base HP regen to greatly increase his survivability in the off-lane. It can also be consumed for instant mana replenishment to be able to cast one more disable or nuke to secure a kill.

entries.name: Observer Ward
lines: Observer Ward can be useful to purchase on Nyx Assassin, as he is a very heavy roamer who can place wards before or after ganks to spot out enemy movement to strike again.

entries.name: Arcane Boots
lines: Arcane Boots are crucial to obtain in order to allow Nyx Assassin to roam for ganks. It increases the size of Nyx Assassin's mana pool, allowing him to more easily cast his full combo of spells, and boosts his movement speed slightly to provide extra mobility. Most importantly, the active allows Nyx Assassin to replenish his own mana pool in order to ensure that he is able to continue roaming without needing to return to base as often.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
lines: Boots of Speed allows Nyx Assassin to chase or flee enemies more easily, and is important for getting within range to cast Impale on a gank target.

entries.name: Urn of Shadows
lines: Urn of Shadows is important to get early on Nyx Assassin, as he can easily get charges from successful ganks. It provides some cheap stats and armor, as well as mana regen for sustaining his mana pool. The charges can be used to restore any HP lost during a gank, or can be used to add more damage to a future gank to increase the odds of success.

entries.name: Magic Wand
lines: Magic Wand gives burst health and mana, useful for Nyx Assassin to cast spells continually.

entries.name: Ghost Scepter
lines: Ghost Scepter is a useful item should Nyx be focused by auto attacks, being usable in tandem with Spiked Carapace for additional survivability, as well as building into Ethereal Blade.

entries.name: Blink Dagger
lines: Blink Dagger greatly increases Nyx Assassin's mobility, allowing him to jump on top of enemies and initiate without relying on Vendetta. In particular, being able to quickly re-position to cast Impale can allow Nyx Assassin to stun multiple enemy heroes at the start of a fight, and in a pinch Spiked Carapace can be used to prevent enemy initiating nukes from putting it on cooldown.

entries.name: Dagon
lines: Dagon greatly boosts Nyx Assassin's burst damage, giving him much more kill potential. The item boosts his intelligence, allowing him to more easily cast his spells, while the active can be used for Mind Flare to deal tremendous burst damage to a single target to secure a kill.

entries.name: Meteor Hammer
lines: Meteor Hammer is useful on Nyx for two reasons: to speed up farming for other items, and to pair with Impale for extended slow and massive bonus damage dealt to your target of choice. The extra building damage also helps whenever your team needs to push.

entries.name: Aghanim's Scepter
lines: Aghanim's Scepter unlocks Burrow, which can give Nyx Assassin a strong tactical advantage against certain enemies. It also improves his overall attributes, aiding in his survivability and buffing up his mana pool.

entries.name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
lines: Eul's Scepter of Divinity is a strong casting item that boosts Nyx Assassin's ability to roam and gank. The increased intelligence and mana regen help to sustain his spell casting, ensuring that he doesn't have to return to base to replenish mana, and the increased movement speed gives him more mobility for hunting down enemies. The cyclone can be used to dispel debuffs from Nyx Assassin while providing temporary invulnerability, or can be cast on an enemy as a further disable.

entries.name: Force Staff
lines: Force Staff is a handy utility item that grants Nyx Assassin many strong bonuses. It provides more intelligence for increasing the size of his mana pool, as well as health regeneration for sustaining his health pool. The active greatly improves Nyx Assassin's mobility, allowing him to re-position for casting his spells, or chasing and escaping more easily. In a pinch, it can also be used as a cheap way to break an enemy Linken's Sphere prior to landing other disables and nukes, and can even be used to re-position Nyx Assassin during Burrow.

entries.name: Aether Lens
lines: Aether Lens will increase Impale and Mana Burn's cast range, which is good to offset their terrible cast animation. It can be built by recycling the Energy Booster you got from Arcane Boots.

entries.name: Daedalus
lines: Daedalus greatly boosts Nyx Assassin's damage from Vendetta, giving him much more kill potential while also allowing his attacks to deal critical damage to enemies.

entries.name: Abyssal Blade
lines: Abyssal Blade will allow Nyx Assassin to instantly stun an enemy hero with Vendetta, making it much more easier to set up Impale and finish them off faster. Abyssal Blade will also allow Nyx Assassin to stun an enemy hero who tries to protect himself/herself with Black King Bar while also providing Nyx Assassin with damage block.

entries.name: Ethereal Blade
lines: Ethereal Blade is a strong nuke booster that improves Nyx Assassin's ability to burst down enemies. As his primary attribute is agility, the bonus agility will increase the damage that Ether Blast deals, which will also greatly slow its target's movement speed while weakening their magic resistance, leaving them wide open for Impale, Mana Burn and Dagon.

entries.name: Bottle
lines: Bottle is a very strong self-sustain item that allows Nyx Assassin to replenish his HP and mana, increasing his autonomy. As he constantly roams, Nyx is able to easily pick up runes to refill his Bottle, and utilize the runes during ganks as needed.

entries.name: Scythe of Vyse
lines: Scythe of Vyse gives Nyx Assassin an instant ranged hard disable, useful in many situations. Also, it gives him stats across the board, particularly improving his intelligence for more mana and providing powerful scaling mana regeneration to allow him to roam independently.

entries.name: Lotus Orb
lines: Lotus Orb allows Nyx Assassin to further use the enemy's spells against them on top of Spiked Carapace. Echo Shell gives Nyx Assassin a tool to reflect enemy spells, and even though it doesn't block the damage done by these spells it can reflect debuffs and stuns rather than just the damage. It also provides armor, increasing Nyx Assassin's survivability, and HP and mana regen for self-sustain.

entries.name: Orchid Malevolence
lines: Orchid Malevolence provides Nyx Assassin with a soft disable that can greatly improve his ability to gank and kill enemies. By silencing an enemy during a gank, Nyx Assassin can prevent them from casting retaliatory disables to get away; as well, his high burst damage can take advantage of the burn damage at the end of the silence to increase the odds of getting a kill during a gank. The item also provides increased intelligence and mana regen, further improving Nyx Assassin's ability to roam independently.

entries.name: Drum of Endurance
lines: Drum of Endurance is a useful stat booster that is easy to build. It gives Nyx Assassin all-around attributes, improving his HP, attack damage and mana. The active can be very useful, as it boosts Nyx Assassin's movement speed, allowing him to chase down enemies quickly.

entries.name: Linken's Sphere
lines: Linken's Sphere greatly improves Nyx Assassin's survivability, and allows him to engage and gank enemies through single-target disables. The Spellblock allows Nyx Assassin to ignore any targeted disables that enemies may try to hit him with, allowing him to continue pursuit and kill the enemy.

pros: Damage reflect is highly tolerable and can create outplay potential.
Can give a big space advantage to his team by ganking the enemy team in the early to mid game.
Can play the role of a semi-tank with Aghanim's Scepter
playstyle.text: Nyx Assassin is a powerful roamer whose burst damage nukes allows him to quickly kill any lone heroes he encounters. While his spells provide relatively little teamfight contribution outside of Impale, his ability to kill the enemy one by one can put the enemy team at a disadvantage in terms of economy, creating opportunities for his team to take advantageous teamfights or outfarm the opposition. However, Nyx Assassin's abilities fall off in the late game, where he plays a more supporting role with his stuns.
cons: Less effective in the late game, so requires teamates that can make the most out of his early/mid advantages.
Low mana to work with early on.
Countered by true sight and spell immunity.
Cannot fight against multiple heroes, particularly those who can create summons and illusions.
Weak against tankier heroes, as they are less likely to be easily bursted down.

lines: Nyx Assassin is always played as a ganker. With Vendetta, his purpose is to slip into hostile territory, and take out enemies, mostly in the jungle. A successful Nyx Assassin is able to shut down the opposing team with repeated assassinations, and intimidate enemies into playing very defensively. A Dagon and Daedalus helps Nyx Assassin greatly, as it allows him to finish off most heroes after using Vendetta.

Nyx Assassin is sometimes played as a support, and usually transforms into a more supporting style during the late game. In this role, his goal is to stun as many enemies as possible with Impale and Spiked Carapace, and pick off dying enemies with Vendetta and Dagon.

Despite his mediocre attribute growth, Nyx Assassin is a deceptively durable hero, as he can take advantage of damage block items in-lane due to being a melee hero and possesses higher-than-average base HP regen. As well, his Spiked Carapace ability allows him to shrug off extremely powerful damage nukes that could kill other heroes.

Nyx Assassin should buy items that increase the size of his mana pool and provide mana replenishment so he can use his abilities continuously to scout and set up kills. Also, items that improve his mobility, nuking, and disabling power will better allow him to find, chase, and kill important targets.

Though Nyx Assassin's abilities have impressive cast ranges, their noticeable cast animation may alert enemies. Thus, you should use his abilities in combination with mobility items like Blink Dagger or under invisibility of Vendetta to catch enemies by surprise.
Nyx Assassin is best played as a roamer or a solo offlaner in order to maximize his effectiveness.
Impale is a ground-targeted disable that stuns and damages enemies in a line in front of Nyx Assassin.

As Nyx Assassin's primary disable, Impale should be maxed out first, as both its damage and stun duration scale as it is leveled up. Its long cast range allows Nyx Assassin to stun enemies from a surprising range.

The area nature of Impale means that it is possible to damage and stun multiple enemy heroes with a single cast. This can be very useful both for initiating engagements by stunning multiple enemy heroes at the start, or for saving fleeing teammates by stopping pursuers in their tracks.

Great skill is required in order to successfully land Impale, as Nyx Assassin's long cast animation, the unreliable ground-targeted nature of the spell, and the travel time of the spell itself can give enemies almost a full second to react if they are far enough away. If a leading stun is not available, good aiming and prediction skills are needed in order to ensure that Impale will successfully stun its intended target.

Impale will still animate if it catches an invisible hero; if a spike elevates with no visible enemy units, it means that the spell has hit an invisible enemy. This can be useful for finding fleeing enemy heroes who may have cast invisibility to escape, as detection or follow-up area stuns and nukes can then be employed to finish them off.

Remember that as Impale is not a reliable targeted stun, it cannot be blocked by Linken's Sphere. Use this to your advantage when initiating on enemies that are relying on its protection, casting a more expendable spell or item ability to break it while the target is stunned.
Mind Flare has huge potential. The damage increases based on how much damage Nyx has dealt in the past 15seconds, so it is best used as a finisher.

Because the ability scales with the damage on the target, burst items, such as Dagon complement it well. Targeting low-health supports can allow Nyx Assassin to quickly remove them from the field before they are able to participate in an engagement.
As well,the damage scales with the intelligence of the target,thus decimating spellcasters.

The damage scaling and cooldown reduction on Mind Flare makes it a good spell to max out early in a match. However, its flat mana cost also prevents Nyx Assassin from utilizing the spell more than a few times in the early game, until he increases the size of his mana pool to accommodate.

Spiked Carapace allows Nyx Assassin to reflect hero damage back to its origin, stunning the attacker while leaving Nyx Assassin unharmed. It can only reflect the first instance per damage source, and only once per cast of Spiked Carapace.

Because it always lasts for the full 2.25 seconds, and is only useful if the enemy attempts to attack Nyx Assassin, Spiked Carapace should be given low priority for maxing out among his spells. One value point in the laning stage can give strong survivability, however the reduced cooldown and longer stun duration are not strictly necessary until later in the game.

Spiked Carapace is a very strong escape spell as it can be used to stun enemy initiators, delaying them from landing follow-up stuns. In the event that Nyx Assassin is ganked, casting Spiked Carapace can buy him enough time to escape or land a counter-stun with Impale.

Because it only reflects the first instance of hero damage, Spiked Carapace is strong against burst damage nukes but less effective against damage over time spells. While it can completely reflect large single-instance damage nukes like Assassinate and Laguna Blade, it is far less effective against multiple damage ticks like Dual Breath and Battery Assault.

Spiked Carapace's cooldown only allows it to be cast once at the start of an engagement, leaving it unable to be cast again until during the pursuit phase. As such, casting it at the right moment is crucial, as the long cooldown leaves little room for error.

Spiked Carapace can be used as a follow-up stun after a successful Impale. Activating Spiked Carapace right as the stun from Impale expires gives Nyx Assassin another opportunity to stun the target, as any counter-nukes or disables that deal damage will be reflected and stun the enemy again. This can be particularly useful against intelligence casters, who may try to target powerful nukes on Nyx Assassin that can be reflected in their full to add to Nyx Assassin's alpha.

Keep in mind that Spiked Carapace only reflects the damage portion of any spell damage, and Nyx Assassin is still fully affected by secondary effects; Light Strike Array and Storm Hammer will still stun, Frost Blast and Venomous Gale will still slow, and so on. Spiked Carapace should not generally be treated as an invulnerability spell, as the enemy can still disable Nyx Assassin for enough time until the spell expires.

Against certain enemies, Spiked Carapace can allow Nyx Assassin to turn their skillshots against them while saving his own life. Knowing when the enemy may attempt to cast long-ranged nukes like Powershot, Rocket Flare, Sun Strike, and even Ice Blast can allow Nyx Assassin to use Spiked Carapace to block the damage instance and deflect it back, possibly even getting a kill if the caster is low enough.

Good timing and reflexes are crucial for effectively using Spiked Carapace, as its instant cast time and short duration can make it hard to use. Activating Spiked Carapace too early can warn the enemy not to cast any damage spells at Nyx Assassin until it expires, while activating it too late will cause Nyx Assassin to take the full damage from an incoming nuke and possibly be disabled and unable to cast it. Casting it at the right time can allow Nyx Assassin to fully reflect powerful damage nukes and stun numerous enemies while remaining relatively unharmed.

Remember that all sources of hero damage can be used to proc Spiked Carapace's stun, which allows Nyx Assassin to use the enemy's area nukes against them. For instance, activating Spiked Carapace on top of Firefly, March of the Machines, Scorched Earth and even an active Radiance can stun the enemy even if they are not trying to directly target Nyx Assassin, which allows it to be used to stun enemies chasing a fleeing ally, stop a retreating enemy in their tracks, and even interrupt escape teleports.

Spiked carapace can be used without breaking Vendetta, allowing you to initiate on heroes that are currently farming with AoE spells or Cleave, then attack with Vendetta and stun with Impale. Some spells are very easy to reflect back to their caster, such as Pugna's Nether Blast or KotL's Illuminate.

Vendetta renders Nyx Assassin instantly invisible, while giving him a movement speed boost and passing through units. Attacking out of invisibility allows him to deal tremendous Pure damage to its target.

Use Vendetta to gank heroes with low health as it does Pure damage. Striking out of invisibility, and then following up with Impale and Mana Burn, are often enough to bring most squishy supports into the red instantly, if not outright kill them.

Be careful about using Vendetta to initiate. Smart enemy players will buy detection early on in order to detect incoming ganks, turning Nyx Assassin into a free kill. Try to initiate only on lone enemies if possible, and don't be afraid to back away if something doesn't feel right.
While the physical burst damage is powerful, there may be times when it is necessary to use Impale from invisibility in order to disable slippery enemy heroes like Anti-Mage.

In a pinch, Vendetta can be used as an escape spell, provided that the enemy does not have detection. The instant fade time can disjoint incoming projectiles, while the movement speed boost may allow him to outrun enemies.

Spiked Carapace can be cast during an active Vendetta without breaking invisibility. If an enemy damage nuke is incoming during Vendetta (a sign that they have detection), activating Spiked Carapace can allow Nyx Assassin to reflect the damage while stunning the enemy, and still have the backstab damage available to use.
Because it does not interrupt channeling, Vendetta can be used during Town Portal Scroll, allowing Nyx Assassin to emerge invisible instantly.
Burrow, unlocked through purchasing Aghanim's Scepter, turns Nyx Assassin invisible while regenerating his HP and mana over time, and boosts the effectiveness of his spells.

Burrow greatly boosts the cast range of Impale and Mana Burn, while almost halving Impale's cooldown time. This can give Nyx Assassin a powerful tactical advantage for striking enemies from a greater range.

Beware that because of its 1 second cast animation, Burrow is very difficult to cast tactically. The principle behind Burrow is to predict enemy movements and lie in wait, then use Nyx Assassin's abilities when a target arrives, springing into action with his spells once surprise has been achieved. Remaining Burrowed in one location for an extended period of time can allow the enemy to approach Nyx Assassin from multiple directions and score an easy kill, or simply avoid him and engage his team 4-vs-5.
The health and mana regeneration allow Nyx Assassin to roam more independently, as he can quickly recover HP and mana by holing up, and utilize his boosted abilities if enemies stumble upon his lair.

Casting Vendetta will instantly unearth Nyx Assassin if he is Burrowed. This can be useful for misdirecting enemies, by hitting them with his spells first and then retreating away invisibly when they respond, ready to strike with Vendetta's backstab damage and a ready Impale.

Try to utilize trees and high ground when casting Burrow. Nyx Assassin is not revealed when casting his spells, however remaining hidden from plain sight can keep him from being stumbled upon with detection and killed. In particular, the longer cast range on Impale and Mana Burn can help him to defend high ground against enemy pushes into his base.

Because it roots Nyx Assassin for the duration of the ability, he is unable to utilize Blink Dagger during Burrow. However, he can still be displaced by other abilities and items, particularly Force Staff, Boulder Smash, Snowball, and so on. This can be useful for utilizing the instant stun from Spiked Carapace in order to stun multiple enemies quickly.

bio:
Глубоко в архивах Ультимира, среди учёных трактатов о кладистике драконов и книгах непереводимых заклинаний, есть древний том с описаниями энтомологических диковин. Составленная учёными книга описывает телепатические способности скарабея-фанатика, странного вида социальных насекомых со способностями, которых нет больше ни у кого во всех семи вселенных.

В отличие от других личинок колонии, Nyx Assassin не превратился в жука с ограниченным мышлением и затупленными конечностями, как большинство членов рабочей касты его вида. Для него было приготовлено особое превращение, благословленное самой Никс. Он был избран, один из множества, и помазан экстрактом самой королевы-богини. Мало кто выживал в полумраке королевских покоев, но он проявил проницательный ум. Его бритвенно-острые жвалы секли воздух, пока разум проникал в мысли тех, кто стоял вокруг него. Среди всех скарабеев-фанатиков, только он один был удостоен наивысшей участи. После нового превращения он переродился, благословленный Никс, со способностями, служащими только одной цели: убивать во имя его богини.

notes.text: Шипы движутся со скоростью в 1600 единиц.
Impale поражает существ на расстоянии до 890 (1415) единиц (складывается из дальности прохождения и радиуса).
Пораженные существа подбрасываются вверх на 350 единиц для базового оглушения на 0,5 секунды.
Пока задетые существа в воздухе, остальные могут под ними проходить.
При попадании по цели видны частички пыли. Этот визуальный эффект отображается даже сквозь туман войны.
Когда Impale поражает невидимых существ, визуальные эффекты под ними остаются видимыми.
Impale вначале наносит урон, а затем накладывает дебафф.
С действующей Burrow при применении Impale не нужно смотреть в сторону применения способности.
C действующей Burrow дальность применения и прохождения увеличивается до 1415 единиц.
Не сбрасывает время перезарядки способности, если она была использована до Burrow.
Может нанести до 117/187,2/257,4/327,6 (280,8/351/421,2/491,4) урона с учётом дебаффа от Vendetta (до снижений).

notes.text: При изучении способности на всех героях, включая Nyx Assassin, появляется счетчик урона.
Счетчик суммирует получаемый целью урон всех типов за последние 15% сек., затем он наносится цели, к которой применяется Mind Flare, как урон от заклинаний.
Количество урона не суммируется от следующих источников:
Урон отнимающий здоровье.
Неотражаемый урон (например Blade Mail).
Счетчик урона обнуляется после применения способности.
Таким образом, будет нанесено количество урона, нанесенное с последнего применения Mind Flare, включая и урон от самой способности.
Применимо к целям без интеллекта (например, крипы-герои и Ogre Magi), но будет наноситься только бонусная часть урона.
С действующей Burrow при применении Mind Flare не нужно смотреть в сторону применения способности.

abilities.description: Наносит выбранному врагу урон, пропорциональный его максимальной мане и сжигает её часть. Также повторяет долю от урона, который владелец способности нанёс жертве за последние 15 сек. Счётчик накопленного урона сбрасывается при срабатывании этой способности.
abilities.name: Mind Flare

notes.text: При использовании Spiked Carapace прерывает произносимые способности Nyx Assassin.
Можно использовать, не раскрывая невидимость от Vendetta, но невидимость от других источников будет раскрыта.
Бафф от нескольких применений не складывается, но обновляет длительность.
Отражает только урон от игроков, возвращая его источнику. Существо затрагивается способностью лишь раз за бафф.
Отражает входящий урон до всех манипуляций. При этом манипуляция уроном на врага влияет на урон по-прежнему.
Отражает тот же тип урона, что и получает.
На отражаемый физический урон также действует блокировка урона.
У отражаемого урона есть следующие свойства:
Неотражаемый урон: не может быть отражён при помощи любых других подобных источников.
Используется тот же модификатор, что и Blade Mail, возвращаемый активной и пассивной способность урон наносит 0, пока Spiked Carapace активна.
Полностью применимо к эффектам от урона на противниках, за исключением тех, у которых есть минимальный порог урона (например, Gravekeeper's Cloak).
Без вампиризма заклинаниями: на него не действует вампиризм заклинаний.
Усиление урона заклинаний: нельзя усилить засчёт усиления урона заклинаний.
Возвращает тот же тип урона, что был нанесён.
У Spiked Carapace глобальная дальность и она действует на невидимых существ и существ в тумане войны.
Игнорирует наносимый себе урон и урон, отмеченный как отнимающий здоровье.
Spiked Carapace сначала применяет дебафф, затем отражает урон.
Spiked Carapace отрицает и отражает урон после всех уменьшений, что предотвращает срабатывание эффектов, реагирующих на урон.
Однако, она не предотвращает срабатывание источников смерти и мгновенного убийства.
У способности приоритет выше, чем у защитных барьеров, отрицая весь урон до того, как он будет поглощён барьерами.
Несмотря на то, что урон, наносимый врагам, равен значению заблокированного урона, эффекты действуют отдельно друг от друга.
То есть Spiked Carapace всегда блокирует один источник наносимого урон, даже если источник обладает иммунитетом к способностям или неуязвим.
Не действует на варды, постройки и союзных существ.
При действующей Burrow способность мгновенно применяет оглушение по всем врагам в радиусе единиц.
Поскольку Spiked Carapace не имеет базового урона, пораженные существа урона также не получат.
Полностью применимо к линейным крипам и нейтральным крипам.
У Nyx Assassin также остается стандартный бафф, который может отражать урон и оглушать врагов.
При этом бафф не влияет на вражеских существ, ранее пораженных оглушением от способности. Они смогут нанести Nyx Assassin урон без каких-либо последствий.

notes: Наносит урон, уменьшенный вашими показателями сопротивления.
Работает только на существ под контролем игроков.
Отражённый урон имеет тот же тип, что и наносимый.
Урон этой способности считается отражённым. Его нельзя отразить вновь, и от него не срабатывает вампиризм.
abilities.lore: Несмотря на то что сам панцирь скарабея довольно тонкий, его надёжно защищают острые как бритва выдвижные шипы.
abilities.description:
Полностью блокирует урон от атаки или способности, по одному разу отражая урон и оглушая каждого, кто пытался его нанести. Не снимает невидимость от способности Vendetta.

Если герой находится под действием Burrow, эта способность мгновенно оглушает всех врагов вокруг.
abilities.name: Spiked Carapace

notes.text: Требует Aghanim's Scepter для разблокировки.
Делает Nyx Assassin невидимым, обезоруживает его и применяет к нему оцепенение, предотвращая его передвижение, атаки и использование Blink Dagger.
Но Nyx Assassin всё ещё можно перемещать с помощью заклинаний и способностей принудительного движения без его выкапывания.
При действующей Burrow Impale и Mind Flare применяются без поворота к цели или выбранной точке.
Для остальных направленных заклинаний и предметов поворот нужен.
Burrow не меняет направление взгляда и скорости поворота героя.
При действующей Burrow применяется общее уменьшение входящего урона. Суммируется с другими источниками манипуляций входящим уроном.
Влияет на все типы получаемого урона. Не уменьшает отнимающий здоровье урон.
Может восстановить до 60% от максимального здоровья и маны в минуту.
Burrow заканчивается при следующих условиях:
При использовании подспособности Unburrow или Vendetta.
При смерти.
При утере Aghanim's Scepter.
При утрате способности Rubick мгновенно выкапывается.

notes: Применив способность Vendetta, герой выкопается из земли.

abilities.description: Герой торопливо закапывается в землю. Там он невидим, получает уменьшенный урон и усиливает свои способности: Spiked Carapace действует на всех окружающих врагов, Mind Flare и Impale получают увеличенную дальность применения, а у Impale уменьшается перезарядка.
abilities.name: Burrow

abilities.description: Герой сжигает ману врагов пропорционально урону, который им наносит.
abilities.name: Mana Burn

notes.text: При использовании Vendetta не прерывает произносимые способности Nyx Assassin.
Атака из Vendetta имеет следующие свойства:
Не может промахнуться.
Учитывая бонус к дальности атаки и радиус привязки, общая дальность атаки будет равна 249 + Радиус привязки цели.
При атаке вначале применяется дебафф, бонус к урону от заклинаний, кража маны макс. и урон от атаки, а затем бонус к анимации атаки.
Во время действия способности предоставляются следующие бонусы:
Бонус к дальности атакив зависимости от типа атаки заклинателя.
Уменьшает время применения перед следующей атакой до +.
Не уменьшает остаточную анимацию применения следующей атаки.
Талант на 25 уровне позволяет Nyx Assassin, помимо прохождения сквозь существ, свободно проходить по возвышенностям и деревьям.
Изучение таланта на беспрепятственное движение не улучшает действующую Vendetta.

Бонус к урону наносится отдельным источником урона и считается за урон от заклинаний, на него действует усиление урона заклинаний и вампиризм заклинаниями. На него не действует и он не учитывается любыми эффектами, влияющими на урон от атаки.
Усиление урона заклинаний и дебафф не работает при атаке по вардам или постройкам.
Невидимость прерывается при использовании способностей или предметов, в момент анимации применения или при попадании атаки в цель.
Невидимость не прерывается в следующих случаях:
Применение Spiked Carapace.
Взятие, бросок, атака предметов и рун.
Для героев с дальним типом атаки это происходит в момент попадания снаряда. Таким образом, бонус к урону не будет применён, если до попадания снаряда в цель в очередь было поставлено другое действие.
Следующее применение обновит значение способности до текущего уровня и обновит длительность невидимости.
Vendetta позволяет Nyx Assassin проходить сквозь остальных существ, включая варды, но исключая строения.
Улучшенная Vendetta применяет к цели усиление входящего урона при выходе из невидимости. Усиление входящего урона складывается с другими источниками манипуляций входящим уроном.
Улучшение влияет только на урон от заклинаний, который получает затронутая цель. Не усиливает следющие источники урона:
Урон от атаки.
Урон отнимающий здоровье.
Несмотря на усиление входящего урона, это не будет работать с источниками, игнорирующими усиление исходящего урона (например, источники прорубающего удара, Damage Return и Moon Glaives).
В общем увеличивает урон заклинателя до 351/468/585 (до снижений).

notes: Если невидимость закончится или прервётся применением способности, герой не нанесёт дополнительного урона.
Истощение от Aghanim's Shard накладывается перед нанесением дополнительного урона.
abilities.lore: Скарабей убивает во славу своей королевы.
abilities.description: Делает героя невидимым и увеличивает его скорость передвижения. Совершив атаку из невидимости, герой нанесёт огромный дополнительный урон и наложит на жертву истощение. Такая атака имеет увеличенную на 75 дальность и ускоренную на 70% анимацию.
abilities.name: Vendetta
abilities.shard: Уменьшает перезарядку на 10 сек. Даёт владельцу свободное перемещение и максимальную скорость на первые 15 сек. действия.

hype: Nyx Assassin всегда охотится за хилыми противниками. Он незаметно крадётся по лесам и, обнаружив жертву, пронзает её острыми когтями и поражает оглушающими шипами, отражая любой ответный удар своим панцирем.
name: Nyx Assassin

talents.right: +25% к отражаемому урону у Spiked Carapace
